1	/**
2	 * runtimeHandles — host-binding adapter that exposes runtime store
3	 * surfaces (permission, mcp, plugin, agent catalog) to higher
4	 * packages. `as any` casts on permission updates bridge between this
5	 * package's `PermissionUpdate[]` and the upstream packages' nominally
6	 * identical-but-distinct declarations. Runtime-binding pattern.
7	 */
8	import type {
9	  AgentCatalogHandle,
10	  HostSessionStore,
11	  McpRuntimeHandle,
12	  McpRuntimeSnapshot,
13	  PermissionRuntimeHandle,
14	  PluginRuntimeHandle,
15	  PluginRuntimeSnapshot,
16	  RuntimeHandles,
17	} from '../index.js'
18	import type { HeadlessStoreParams } from '@thyrox/cli'
19	import {
20	  applyPermissionUpdates,
21	  persistPermissionUpdates,
22	} from '@thyrox/permission/PermissionUpdate'
23	import type { PermissionUpdate } from '@thyrox/permission/PermissionUpdateSchema'
24	import type { ToolPermissionContext } from '@thyrox/tool-registry/Tool.js'
25	import { getEmptyToolPermissionContext } from '@thyrox/tool-registry/Tool.js'
26	import type { AppState } from './appStateCompatShim.js'
27	import { getDefaultAppState } from './appStateCompatShim.js'
28	import { createHeadlessSessionStore } from '@thyrox/agent/sessionStores.js'
29	import { createStore, type Store } from '@thyrox/repl/stateStore.js'
30	import type { AgentDefinitionsResult } from '@thyrox/tool-registry/tools/AgentTool/loadAgentsDir.js'
31	import type { LoadedPlugin, PluginError } from '@thyrox/config/plugin/types'
32	import type { Command } from '@thyrox/command-runtime/runtime'
33	import type {
34	  MCPServerConnection,
35	  ScopedMcpServerConfig,
36	  ServerResource,
37	} from '@thyrox/mcp-runtime/types.js'
38	
39	type SnapshotStore<T> = Store<T>
40	
41	function createSnapshotStore<T>(initialState: T): SnapshotStore<T> {
42	  return createStore(initialState)
43	}
44	
45	type RuntimeHandleSet = RuntimeHandles & {
46	  permission: PermissionRuntimeHandle<ToolPermissionContext, PermissionUpdate>
47	  mcp: McpRuntimeHandle<
48	    MCPServerConnection,
49	    unknown,
50	    Command,
51	    ServerResource,
52	    ScopedMcpServerConfig
53	  >
54	  plugins: PluginRuntimeHandle<LoadedPlugin, Command, PluginError>
55	  agentCatalog: AgentCatalogHandle<AgentDefinitionsResult>
56	  sessionStoreFactory: {
57	    createHeadlessStore: (
58	      params?: HeadlessStoreParams,
59	    ) => HostSessionStore<AppState>
60	  }
61	}
62	
63	export function createRuntimeHandles(
64	  initialState: AppState = (() => {
65	    try {
66	      return getDefaultAppState()
67	    } catch {
68	      return {
69	        toolPermissionContext: getEmptyToolPermissionContext(),
70	        mcp: {
71	          clients: [],
72	          tools: [],
73	          commands: [],
74	          resources: {},
75	          pluginReconnectKey: 0,
76	        },
77	        plugins: {
78	          enabled: [],
79	          disabled: [],
80	          commands: [],
81	          errors: [],
82	          installationStatus: {
83	            marketplaces: [],
84	            plugins: [],
85	          },
86	          needsRefresh: false,
87	        },
88	        agentDefinitions: { activeAgents: [], allAgents: [] },
89	      } as AppState
90	    }
91	  })(),
92	): RuntimeHandleSet {
93	  const permissionStore = createSnapshotStore(initialState.toolPermissionContext)
94	  const mcpStore = createSnapshotStore<McpRuntimeSnapshot<
95	    MCPServerConnection,
96	    unknown,
97	    Command,
98	    ServerResource
99	  >>({
100	    clients: initialState.mcp.clients,
101	    tools: initialState.mcp.tools,
102	    commands: initialState.mcp.commands,
103	    resources: initialState.mcp.resources,
104	  })
105	  const pluginStore = createSnapshotStore<
106	    PluginRuntimeSnapshot<LoadedPlugin, Command, PluginError>
107	  >({
108	    enabled: initialState.plugins.enabled,
109	    disabled: initialState.plugins.disabled,
110	    commands: initialState.plugins.commands,
111	    errors: initialState.plugins.errors,
112	    installationStatus: initialState.plugins.installationStatus,
113	    needsRefresh: initialState.plugins.needsRefresh,
114	  })
115	  const agentCatalogStore = createSnapshotStore(initialState.agentDefinitions)
116	
117	  return {
118	    permission: {
119	      getContext: () => permissionStore.getState(),
120	      setContext: next => permissionStore.setState(() => next),
121	      buildUpdates: (...args: unknown[]) =>
122	        (Array.isArray(args[0]) ? args[0] : []) as PermissionUpdate[],
123	      applyUpdates: updates => {
124	        let nextContext = permissionStore.getState()
125	        nextContext = applyPermissionUpdates(nextContext as any, updates)
126	        permissionStore.setState(() => nextContext)
127	        return nextContext
128	      },
129	      persistUpdates: updates => {
130	        persistPermissionUpdates(updates as any)
131	      },
132	    },
133	    mcp: {
134	      getSnapshot: () => mcpStore.getState(),
135	      setSnapshot: snapshot => mcpStore.setState(() => snapshot),
136	      subscribe: listener => mcpStore.subscribe(listener),
137	      refresh: () => {},
138	      getResources: serverName =>
139	        mcpStore.getState().resources[serverName] ?? [],
140	    },
141	    plugins: {
142	      getSnapshot: () => pluginStore.getState(),
143	      setSnapshot: snapshot => pluginStore.setState(() => snapshot),
144	      subscribe: listener => pluginStore.subscribe(listener),
145	      refresh: () => {},
146	    },
147	    agentCatalog: {
148	      getDefinitions: () => agentCatalogStore.getState(),
149	      setDefinitions: next => agentCatalogStore.setState(() => next),
150	      refresh: () => {},
151	    },
152	    sessionStoreFactory: {
153	      createHeadlessStore: params =>
154	        createHeadlessSessionStore(
155	          (params ?? {
156	            mcpClients: [],
157	            mcpCommands: [],
158	            mcpTools: [],
159	            toolPermissionContext: permissionStore.getState(),
160	            effort: undefined,
161	            effectiveModel: null,
162	          }) as HeadlessStoreParams,
163	        ),
164	    },
165	  }
166	}
167	
168	export function syncRuntimeHandlesFromAppState(
169	  handles: RuntimeHandles,
170	  state: AppState,
171	): void {
172	  handles.permission.setContext(state.toolPermissionContext)
173	  handles.mcp.setSnapshot?.({
174	    clients: state.mcp.clients,
175	    tools: state.mcp.tools,
176	    commands: state.mcp.commands,
177	    resources: state.mcp.resources,
178	  })
179	  handles.plugins.setSnapshot?.({
180	    enabled: state.plugins.enabled,
181	    disabled: state.plugins.disabled,
182	    commands: state.plugins.commands,
183	    errors: state.plugins.errors,
184	    installationStatus: state.plugins.installationStatus,
185	    needsRefresh: state.plugins.needsRefresh,
186	  })
187	  handles.agentCatalog.setDefinitions?.(state.agentDefinitions)
188	}
189	
190	export function syncRuntimeHandlesFromHeadlessParams(
191	  handles: RuntimeHandles,
192	  params: HeadlessStoreParams,
193	): void {
194	  handles.permission.setContext(params.toolPermissionContext)
195	  handles.mcp.setSnapshot?.({
196	    clients: params.mcpClients,
197	    tools: params.mcpTools,
198	    commands: params.mcpCommands as Command[],
199	    resources: {},
200	  })
201	}

10	// de este pase. Se omiten esos 5 símbolos aquí; el resto del archivo
11	// se porta verbatim.
12	//

14	// (context/QueuedMessageContext.tsx, context/notifications.tsx):
15	// ninguno de los dos es capa 0 por el criterio de "cita a paquete
16	// hermano" (0 hits de @claude-code-how-works en ambos), pero los dos
17	// requieren `react` y QueuedMessageContext.tsx además `@anthropic/ink`
18	// — medido: ninguno de los dos existe en node_modules de este árbol
19	// (`find . -maxdepth 6 -iname react -type d` → 0 resultados). Instalar
20	// React es decisión del ejecutor, no de este pase.

export type RuntimeBindingInstallers = {
  installCorePackageBindings?: () => void
  installProviderBindings?: () => void
  installToolRegistryBindings?: () => void
  installCommandRuntimeBindings?: () => void
  installMcpRuntimeBindings?: () => void
  installCliBindings?: () => void
}

export type HostSessionStore<TState = unknown> = {
  getState: () => TState
  setState: (updater: (prev: TState) => TState) => void
  subscribe: (listener: () => void) => () => void
}

export type PermissionRuntimeHandle<TContext = unknown, TUpdate = unknown> = {
  getContext: () => TContext
  setContext: (next: TContext) => void
  buildUpdates: (...args: unknown[]) => TUpdate[]
  applyUpdates: (updates: TUpdate[]) => TContext
  persistUpdates: (updates: TUpdate[]) => void
}

export type McpRuntimeSnapshot<
  TMcpClient = unknown,
  TMcpTool = unknown,
  TMcpCommand = unknown,
  TMcpResource = unknown,
> = {
  clients: TMcpClient[]
  tools: TMcpTool[]
  commands: TMcpCommand[]
  resources: Record<string, TMcpResource[]>
}

export type McpRuntimeHandle<
  TMcpClient = unknown,
  TMcpTool = unknown,
  TMcpCommand = unknown,
  TMcpResource = unknown,
  TMcpConfig = unknown,
> = {
  getSnapshot: () => McpRuntimeSnapshot<
    TMcpClient,
    TMcpTool,
    TMcpCommand,
    TMcpResource
  >
  setSnapshot?: (
    snapshot: McpRuntimeSnapshot<
      TMcpClient,
      TMcpTool,
      TMcpCommand,
      TMcpResource
    >,
  ) => void
  subscribe: (listener: () => void) => () => void
  refresh: (configs?: Record<string, TMcpConfig>) => Promise<void> | void
  getResources: (serverName: string) => TMcpResource[]
}

export type PluginRuntimeSnapshot<
  TPlugin = unknown,
  TPluginCommand = unknown,
  TPluginError = unknown,
> = {
  enabled: TPlugin[]
  disabled: TPlugin[]
  commands: TPluginCommand[]
  errors: TPluginError[]
  installationStatus: {
    marketplaces: Array<{
      name: string
      status: 'pending' | 'installing' | 'installed' | 'failed'
      error?: string
    }>
    plugins: Array<{
      id: string
      name: string
      status: 'pending' | 'installing' | 'installed' | 'failed'
      error?: string
    }>
  }
  needsRefresh: boolean
}

export type PluginRuntimeHandle<
  TPlugin = unknown,
  TPluginCommand = unknown,
  TPluginError = unknown,
> = {
  getSnapshot: () => PluginRuntimeSnapshot<TPlugin, TPluginCommand, TPluginError>
  setSnapshot?: (
    snapshot: PluginRuntimeSnapshot<TPlugin, TPluginCommand, TPluginError>,
  ) => void
  subscribe: (listener: () => void) => () => void
  refresh: () => Promise<void> | void
}

export type AgentCatalogHandle<TAgentDefinitions = unknown> = {
  getDefinitions: () => TAgentDefinitions
  setDefinitions?: (next: TAgentDefinitions) => void
  refresh: () => Promise<void> | void
}

export type SessionStoreFactory = {
  createHeadlessStore?: (params?: unknown) => HostSessionStore
}

  permission: PermissionRuntimeHandle
  mcp: McpRuntimeHandle
  plugins: PluginRuntimeHandle
  agentCatalog: AgentCatalogHandle
  sessionStoreFactory: SessionStoreFactory
}

export type RuntimeGraph = {
  createdAt: number
  handles: RuntimeHandles

2	 * runtimeHandles — host-binding adapter that exposes runtime store
3	 * surfaces (permission, mcp, plugin, agent catalog) to higher
4	 * packages. `as any` casts on permission updates bridge between this
5	 * package's `PermissionUpdate[]` and the upstream packages' nominally
6	 * identical-but-distinct declarations. Runtime-binding pattern.

63	export function createRuntimeHandles(
64	  initialState: AppState = (() => {
65	    try {
66	      return getDefaultAppState()
67	    } catch {
68	      return {
69	        toolPermissionContext: getEmptyToolPermissionContext(),
70	        mcp: {
71	          clients: [],
72	          tools: [],

85	          },
86	          needsRefresh: false,
87	        },
88	        agentDefinitions: { activeAgents: [], allAgents: [] },
89	      } as AppState
90	    }
91	  })(),
92	): RuntimeHandleSet {
93	  const permissionStore = createSnapshotStore(initialState.toolPermissionContext)
94	  const mcpStore = createSnapshotStore<McpRuntimeSnapshot<
95	    MCPServerConnection,
96	    unknown,
97	    Command,
98	    ServerResource
99	  >>({
100	    clients: initialState.mcp.clients,
101	    tools: initialState.mcp.tools,

103	    resources: initialState.mcp.resources,

105	  const pluginStore = createSnapshotStore<
106	    PluginRuntimeSnapshot<LoadedPlugin, Command, PluginError>
107	  >({
108	    enabled: initialState.plugins.enabled,
109	    disabled: initialState.plugins.disabled,
110	    commands: initialState.plugins.commands,
111	    errors: initialState.plugins.errors,

115	  const agentCatalogStore = createSnapshotStore(initialState.agentDefinitions)
116	
117	  return {
118	    permission: {
119	      getContext: () => permissionStore.getState(),
120	      setContext: next => permissionStore.setState(() => next),
121	      buildUpdates: (...args: unknown[]) =>
122	        (Array.isArray(args[0]) ? args[0] : []) as PermissionUpdate[],
123	      applyUpdates: updates => {
124	        let nextContext = permissionStore.getState()
125	        nextContext = applyPermissionUpdates(nextContext as any, updates)
126	        permissionStore.setState(() => nextContext)
127	        return nextContext
128	      },
129	      persistUpdates: updates => {
130	        persistPermissionUpdates(updates as any)
131	      },
132	    },
133	    mcp: {
134	      getSnapshot: () => mcpStore.getState(),
135	      setSnapshot: snapshot => mcpStore.setState(() => snapshot),
136	      subscribe: listener => mcpStore.subscribe(listener),
137	      refresh: () => {},
138	      getResources: serverName =>
139	        mcpStore.getState().resources[serverName] ?? [],
140	    },

143	      setSnapshot: snapshot => pluginStore.setState(() => snapshot),

149	      setDefinitions: next => agentCatalogStore.setState(() => next),
150	      refresh: () => {},
151	    },
152	    sessionStoreFactory: {
153	      createHeadlessStore: params =>
154	        createHeadlessSessionStore(
155	          (params ?? {
156	            mcpClients: [],
157	            mcpCommands: [],
158	            mcpTools: [],
159	            toolPermissionContext: permissionStore.getState(),
160	            effort: undefined,
161	            effectiveModel: null,
162	          }) as HeadlessStoreParams,
163	        ),
164	    },
165	  }
166	}

168	export function syncRuntimeHandlesFromAppState(
169	  handles: RuntimeHandles,
170	  state: AppState,
171	): void {
172	  handles.permission.setContext(state.toolPermissionContext)
173	  handles.mcp.setSnapshot?.({
174	    clients: state.mcp.clients,
175	    tools: state.mcp.tools,
176	    commands: state.mcp.commands,

185	    needsRefresh: state.plugins.needsRefresh,
186	  })

188	}

198	    commands: params.mcpCommands as Command[],

200	  })

content.text:
Confirmado: ambas líneas son únicas en el archivo. La causa raíz es la misma en los dos diagnósticos: `RuntimeHandleSet` intersecta cada handle (`PluginRuntimeHandle`, `AgentCatalogHandle`, con genéricos por defecto `unknown`) con su instancia concreta, y TypeScript infiere el parámetro contravariante del `set*` como la unión de ambas instanciaciones — necesario para que la propiedad siga siendo asignable a la intersección, pero incorrecto para el cuerpo, que sólo maneja la forma concreta. Anotar el parámetro rompería la asignabilidad externa, así que la afirmación de tipo va en el punto de uso, respaldada por que los únicos llamadores reales (`syncRuntimeHandlesFromAppState`) siempre entregan la forma concreta.

```json

 "edits": [
   {"old": "      setSnapshot: snapshot => pluginStore.setState(() => snapshot),",
    "new": "      // TS infiere `snapshot` como unión con la instancia `unknown` del\n      // contrato genérico (necesaria para la asignabilidad externa de la\n      // intersección); se afirma el tipo concreto sólo aquí, donde los\n      // llamadores reales siempre entregan esa forma.\n      setSnapshot: snapshot =>\n        pluginStore.setState(\n          () => snapshot as PluginRuntimeSnapshot<LoadedPlugin, Command, PluginError>,\n        ),"},
   {"old": "      setDefinitions: next => agentCatalogStore.setState(() => next),",
    "new": "      // Mismo caso que `plugins.setSnapshot`: `next` se infiere `unknown`\n      // por el mismo contrato genérico sin parametrizar.\n      setDefinitions: next =>\n        agentCatalogStore.setState(() => next as AgentDefinitionsResult),"}
 ],
 "patterns": [
   {"patron": "contravariant-param-widened-by-generic-default-intersection",
    "senal_del_verificador": "TS2322: Type '(?:unknown|\\w+<[^']*unknown[^']*>\\s*\\|\\s*\\w+<[^']+>)' is not assignable to type '",
    "fix_generico": "Cuando una propiedad tipo-función de un contrato con genéricos por defecto (`unknown`) se sobreescribe con una instancia concreta vía intersección (`Base & { prop: Base<Concreto> }`), TypeScript infiere el parámetro contravariante de esa propiedad (`set*`/`on*`), dentro del cuerpo de la función, como la unión de la instancia `unknown` y la concreta — ese ensanchamiento es lo que mantiene la propiedad asignable a la intersección. No se corrige anotando el parámetro (eso rompe esa asignabilidad externa): se afirma el tipo concreto sólo en el punto donde el cuerpo usa el valor (`as TipoConcreto`), apoyado en que los llamadores reales de esa propiedad en el árbol siempre construyen la forma concreta.",
    "edits": [0, 1]}
 ],
```
